subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘BUTTON’ is coded as ‘CTVRRK’ and ‘ACTUAL’ is coded as ‘BBVSDI’. How will ‘STRONG’ be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

‘BUTTON’ is coded as ‘CTVRRK’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dca00690a58a36e6f5ef51020a1de06164799792047b6383008196f5ae20291d.png] 

And,

‘ACTUAL’ is coded as ‘BBVSDI’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/028dc656d3f099de24a0e2b1888820e45c4f8b465d1f4831feef7ea6326ff4eb.png] 

Similarly,

‘STRONG’ will be coded as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c6adb86c0b3b016d16c4317b5b456ef92f3337f06b8981caa29c1caab2ae200.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
